title: Te Moe o ngā Tau
intro: Kei te tata koe ki te tīmata i tētahi haerenga i roto i te wā, ka tūtaki ki tētahi mea ngaro hohonu o te whakapono me te mana atua. Whakaarohia tētahi rōpū tāngata i whakahē i ngā tikanga o tō rātou hapori, e piri ana ki te whakapono kotahi i roto i tētahi ao whakapono atua. Ko tā rātou kōrero he tohu i te kaha o Allah ki te tiaki i āna pononga tika i roto i ngā huarahi tino whakamiharo. Ka taea e koe te wetewete i te tuakiri o ēnei tāngata whakamiharo?
clues: He rōpū taitamariki iti mātou i whakapono ki te Atua kotahi, ahakoa te horapa o te karakia atuakore i waenganui i tō mātou iwi.
I rere mātou i tētahi rangatira nanakia i whakawehi i a mātou mō tō mātou whakapono, i te wehi kei whakatoihia mātou me te mate.
I rapu piringa mātou ki tētahi wāhi mokemoke, me te tumanako ki te aroha me te tiaki a Allah i ō mātou kaitukino.
Nā tō tātou Ariki tātou i mea kia moe hohonu, he moe merekara i whakakeke i te tere o te wā.
I tō mātou oho ake, i mahara mātou he rā kotahi, he wāhanga rānei o te rā i okioki ai mātou, kāore i te mōhio ki te wā roa kua pahemo.
E kī ana te Quran i noho tātou i roto i tō tātou āhua mō ngā tau e toru rau, ā, i neke atu i te iwa tau, ka waiho hei tohu mō te tangata.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te tūtaki ki tētahi waipuke nui
Te whakangaromanga o tō rātou tāone

outcome.label: Hua
options: I whakawhiwhia rātou ki te taonga nui me te mana nui
I hurihia rātou hei makimaki me hei poaka
I whakaarahia rātou i te moe hei tohu hohonu
I toremi rātou i roto i te waipuke nui
I hanga e rātou tētahi kingitanga whakahīhī
outcome.answer: I whakaarahia rātou i te moe hei tohu hohonu

verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (Al-Kahf 18:25)
arabic: وَلَبِثُوا فِي كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَاثَ مِائَةٍ سِنِينَ وَازْدَادُوا تِسْعًا
